scope: E阶段关键冲突与开局资料审阅

user_plot_anchor_decision.effect: 记录当时先审资料、不另选无条件未来结果的范围；后续因果原则已由UCL_20261003_001明确，现已按继续档案指令完成本轮事件条件整理。

canon_acceptance: No blanket human approval inferred from a request to review.

established_facts_and_causality.rule: Preserve settled world facts and pre-opening history; independent actors continue unless relevant causal conditions actually change.
confirmed_examples: Tower attack and White Wizard escape are not cancelled merely by different Yulinfeng choices.
established_facts_and_causality.growth_wording: Restore the documented pre-entry settlement; no new enablement gate inferred from a missing separate approval post.

growth_policy.opening: Reconstruct the chosen initial state from original records.
growth_policy.player: User chooses a new growth path after opening; no original future progression queue.
growth_policy.companion_npcs: Grow over time within the user-provided character templates; event awards require current-branch conditions.
growth_policy.archive: Keep historical records; stop work whose sole purpose is reproducing post-opening protagonist progression.

event_causality_application.autonomous_actions: Continue under evidenced conditions; no automatic suspension for different PC choices.
event_causality_application.affected_outcomes: Reassess only when new actions change relevant causes.

dream_handling.user_quote: 梦境是否是额外的context开销，其实我认为不演出，或者存入它们也没什么关系
dream_handling.working_default: Preserve existing dream archives; omit dream performance and loading by default. No additional dream expansion needed for main-world archive completion.
dream_handling.optional_use: Read only relevant fragments for a specific inquiry or a later request to play a dream.
dream_handling.export_plan: Omit dream content from the default deliverable entirely: no dream lorebook/card embedding, global/character/persona/chat binding, prompt fields or retrieval corpus. Optional dream package only on a later explicit request. This is a design constraint, not an implemented export.
dream_handling.mainworld_effects: Only opening-established or actual new-branch effects enter current state. Original later dream rewards are not automatically inherited.
dream_handling.latest_explicit_request: 请设计成避免酒馆加载它的样子，之后则是沐透和大墓地线，有处理的必要吗
dream_handling.scope_unit: Passage/claim, not whole post or file; mixed dream/main-world sources must be segmented.

runtime_content_routing.default_selection: approved main-world claims valid for the selected period and actual branch state

side_lines.treatment: Source provenance only. Integrate evidence into the shared background setting, faction/location/concept/event topics and common character dossiers. Select runtime content by topic, entity, valid time and current relevance, never by campaign-source line.
side_lines.player_knowledge: requires an actual supported information route
side_lines.user_preference_quote: 那么比起载入旁线，把它们的设定放入背景设定集不是更方便简洁吗
side_lines.deduplication: One shared entity/topic with multiple source references; preserve conflicts, historical validity and character knowledge separately.

runtime_content_routing.verification: Use the existing export inventory and one G-stage assembled-prompt inspection; no per-turn audit.
